findings.text: a reading observed in the future is clamped by max(0.0, ...) to age 0.0 and reported as a trusted position -- measured with an observation ten minutes ahead: requeried False, age_seconds 0.0, the probe not asked (reviewer-edge-probe.log edge-future) -- so a clock-skewed or invented future timestamp is rendered as perfect freshness and stays trusted for a further full shelf life, while the module's own rule at :41-43 refuses to trust an observation time that cannot show the reading inside one; no test covers a future observation.

a reading carrying no figure (used_percent None) inside its shelf life is returned as a position with requeried False and the probe untouched (measured: reviewer-edge-probe.log edge-nofigure, probe_calls 0), while the same shape arriving as a probe answer is by :98-99 a failed re-query -- absence of a figure is refused when the reading answers but trusted when the reading is the input, so a caller receives a position with no number and nothing re-queried; no test covers a figure-less input.
